name: avatar
description: A circular user representation with image, initials fallback, 3 sizes, and optional online/offline status indicator.

accessibility.screenReaderName: Use full name as alt or aria-label. Never expose initials as the only name.
accessibility.badge: Pair avatar-indicator with an accessible status label on the avatar wrapper (e.g. aria-label="Online"). The dot color alone is not screen-reader accessible.

constraints: Use Image when a photo URL is available.
Avatar is display-only unless wrapped in a button or anchor.
Do not use avatar-indicator as a standalone component outside of avatar.
Do not detach avatar-indicator for customisation — switch type= variant instead.
Match avatar-indicator size to avatar size: size=Default (8px) for Size=SM, size=large (12px) for Size=Default and Size=LG.

useCases: User profile headers where a photo or initials identifies the account owner at a glance
Comment threads and activity feeds where each entry is attributed to a specific person
Team member lists and collaborator panels in project or document views
Table rows representing people (paired with name and role text)
Chat interfaces where each message is associated with its sender
Dropdown or popover triggers that open a user account menu

Image.whenToUse: A verified photo URL is available — always prefer this over Fallback

Fallback.whenToUse: No photo exists or fails to load — show 1–2 initials
examples: New user who skipped photo upload
SSO user with no avatar on file

SM.whenToUse: Dense contexts where the avatar supports other content rather than leads it

Default.whenToUse: Standard use — comfortable size for lists, cards, and comment threads

LG.whenToUse: The avatar is the primary visual anchor of the view

Badge=True.whenToUse: A presence or availability signal is needed alongside the identity

comparedTo.situation: Showing a user's identity (photo or initials)
comparedTo.notInstead: a raw circle frame with image fill

comparedTo.situation: Showing online/offline presence status overlaid on a user identity
Showing a category label, count, or status chip unrelated to a person
Showing a small thumbnail for a product, file, or non-person entity

notes: Examples assume an Agentic wrapper API over shadcn Avatar primitives.
R3 fixed 2026-05-28: Fallback label fill changed from color/background/muted/foreground → color/surface/muted/foreground to match the color/surface/muted container (paired-surface rule).

R8 fixed 2026-05-28: avatar-indicator fill override cleared on all Badge=True variants; avatar-indicator sub-component provides its own fill token (color/status/success / color/status/offline) — no override needed on the avatar instance.

2026-05-28: avatar-badge renamed to avatar-indicator. Redesigned as pure online/offline presence dot — removed Type=Dot/Icon and ring stroke. New variants: type=online/offline × size=Default/large (4 total).

darkMode.notes: No known dark mode differences — all tokens are semantic and mode-aware.
